newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 300 mln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 300 mln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 300 million francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
It accepted bids for 33.9 billion francs in new liquidity, 300 million more than the 33.6 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on November 19.
The Bank of France said it allocated 10.1 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 2.7 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 23.8 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 10.4 percent of this demand.
